name: Agentic Beta Testers
description: AI-powered browser testing against any URL using personality-driven agents -- speedrunners, chaos gremlins, skeptical executives -- each surfacing different categories of usability and reliability issues.
longDescription:
Ships **1 command**, `beta-test` (Run AI-powered browser testing against any URL using personality-driven agents).

Installs with `claude plugin install agentic-beta-testers@claude-community` from `rjspence3/claude-beta-tester`.

Once listed in the Claude plugin directory:

AI-powered browser testing against any URL using personality-driven agents -- speedrunners, chaos gremlins, skeptical executives -- each surfacing different categories of usability and reliability issues.
